about_the_game:
Synopsis

Fifty years in the future, a plucky investigator named Pandora is caught in a snowstorm. Seeking shelter, she unknowingly steps into Konekomi Castle, finding mysterious, one-eyed aliens. You'll need to earn trust, tell lies, and befriend strangers to unearth the castle's extraordinary secrets.

Find Your Own Way Through

The castle is filled with keycard doors and unmarked elevators. Crawl through vents, steal items, or befriend any Konekomi willing to talk to you.

Explore The Characters

Each Konekomi has their own name and personality. Some already have rivalries and friendships, and you can become a part of those bonds.

Unlock Different Endings

The items you find and the relationships you make are up to you, with multiple endings waiting to be uncovered. No two playthroughs are the same, with a new item gained for every ending. Save your journey anywhere by snapping a photo with your holo-camera, and continue from there anytime.
